finding: The fixed page raster visibly contains the CMA logo words, but the born digital PDF text layer omitted them. Apple Vision returned CMAY instead of CMA and correctly returned Competition & Markets Authority.
limitations: The implementation team inspected this page after the first OCR run, so the correction is not sealed test evidence.
The saved raster and correction record are mutable local files and have no external anchor.
This correction fixes an incomplete oracle. It does not establish OCR accuracy on customer scans.
